component.subject: Benediction
component.source: W. E. Orchard, The Order of Divine Service (1921), A Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper, p. 118: the hymn rubric and Benediction (John 14:27). Lightly modernised.

original.p: (Here the President may announce a Hymn, saying, And when they had sung a hymn they went out.)
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

block.rubric: A hymn may first be sung: "And when they had sung a hymn, they went out"
block.p: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you: not as the world gives, give I to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.
